tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The key investor information (2 pages, the 2026-02-17 edition in the library, unchanged on 2026-11-07) prints the fund's return and its benchmark's for each calendar year 2016 to 2025 on p. 2; they are in tracking_record. Fund basis: 'Includes ongoing charges and the reinvestment of income ... Has been calculated in USD'; one decimal as printed. Benchmark as the document names it: 'Index'. The KIID names the index as the Standard and Poor's 500 Index and does not say net or gross; the same share class's factsheet (library be6b56d18242118d / 97b49e692be6c260, p. 2) names its benchmark 'S&P 500 Net Total Return' ('reinvested dividends less 30% withholding tax'). The difference is not computed here (data-update rule).

yield.notes: The figure as the page prints it; its visible label is 'Historical performance', and that it is a trailing yield is inferred from two things: the page's own field name for that label (yieldHeader) and the arithmetic. The table above it lists 0.3096, 0.3236, 0.3296 and 0.2991 USD a unit (ex-dates 17 Sep 2026, 18 Jun 2026, 19 Mar 2026, 18 Dec 2025), 1.2619 USD together, which is 0.88% of the 143.65 USD net asset value at 30 Oct 2026. Not the factsheet's 'Equity yield (dividend) 1.1%', which the factsheet says 'applies to the underlying holdings of the ETF, and not the ETF itself' (library 97b49e692be6c260, p. 3). Payments a year: 'Distribution frequency Quarterly' on the same page.
